title: HOUST (New Privately-Owned Housing Units Started) — real-time vintage table of 2024 estimates as of 2024-09-18
text:
HOUST — New Privately-Owned Housing Units Started
Source: ALFRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis archival FRED), series HOUST. Underlying data: U.S. Census Bureau. Units: thousands of units, SAAR.
Revision schedule: first estimate mid-month; revised in each of the next two monthly releases.

VINTAGE TABLE — the value of HOUST for each reference month exactly as published on each pre-cutoff release (vintage) date. Reading across a row shows how the estimate for that month was revised in later releases.
